description: This file contains utility functions for system information retrieval, process management, and system control, specific to a network device or embedded system environment. It defines functions for getting MAC addresses, IP addresses, system reboot, uptime, identifying model and firmware version, and managing cron jobs.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the WAN interface based on device type.

methods.name: getSHA1
methods.description: Calculates the SHA1 checksum of a given file.

methods.name: getIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the machine, considering IPv4 or IPv6 status.

methods.name: getCMIPAddress
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the Cable Modem or relevant device, varies with device type.

methods.name: getErouterIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the eRouter's IP address, fallback to IP address if not available.

methods.name: processCheck
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given name is running; returns 1 if not running, 0 if running.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the device, varies with device type and system.

methods.name: getErouterMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the eRouter interface.

methods.name: rebootFunc
methods.description: Performs a system reboot, with special handling for specific device types.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Returns firmware version information from version.txt.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines and returns the build type: 'vbn', 'prod', 'qa', or 'dev'.

methods.name: removeCron
methods.description: Removes a specific cron job identified by a pattern.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Adds a new cron job to the crontab.
